fr_html: M. ADATCI répond que d'après lui, les deux articles doivent être considérés en bloc. Il peut cependant consentir à ce que son amendement soit considéré comme se rapportant à l'article 30.
en_html: M. ADATCI answered that he thought the two Articles should be considered together. He would consent, however, to have his amendment considered as relating to Article 30.
